Mr. SCHUMER (for himself, Mr. Rounds, Mr. Rubio, Mrs. Gillibrand, Mr. Young, and Mr. Heinrich) submitted an amendment intended to be proposed by him to the bill S. 2226 ... which was ordered to lie on the table'.

The amendment Schumer submitted is the text enacted in the Senate as Division G of S. 2226, secs. 9001-9015, containing the eminent-domain provision (sec. 9010) and the nine-member Review Board (sec. 9007).

label: Charles E. Schumer
narrative: Schumer is the author of the only piece of United States legislation ever drafted on the explicit premise that the Federal Government holds recovered non-human technology and has hidden it. On 13 July 2023, as Senate Majority Leader, he submitted S.Amdt. 797 to S. 2226, the FY2024 NDAA, for himself and Senators Rounds, Rubio, Gillibrand, Young and Heinrich; its text was printed in the Congressional Record at Vol. 169 No. 120, pages S2953-S2959. The amendment carried a legal definition of 'non-human intelligence,' a legal definition of 'legacy program' reaching private contractors and academic institutions, a nine-member Records Review Board appointed by the President with the advice and consent of the Senate, and — at Section __10(a), later Section 9010(a) of Division G of the engrossed bill — a command that 'The Federal Government shall exercise eminent domain over any and all recovered technologies of unknown origin and biological evidence of non-human intelligence that may be controlled by private persons or entities in the interests of the public good.' The Senate passed S. 2226 carrying that division on 27 July 2023. By the time the conference product was signed on 22 December 2023 the Review Board, the eminent domain clause, the Controlled Disclosure Campaign Plan and the $20,000,000 authorization were gone; only Sections 1841-1843 survived. Schumer framed the effort as inheriting Harry Reid's project, telling reporters he was 'honored to carry on the legacy of my mentor and dear friend Harry Reid,' and after the gutting said it was 'really an outrage the House didn't work with us on adopting our proposal for a review board.' He re-filed the full text through Rounds as S.Amdt. 2610 in July 2024. It never got a vote.
